scopeStatement: Synthetic offline policy/provenance regression through the real application and assessment path with mocked search, original-source, and model providers. The mocked model also supplies the fixture hypothesis as a suggestion in suggestion scenarios. These rows do not measure model interpretation or suggestion accuracy, market demand, or product usefulness.

manualReview.assessmentRationale: Outcomes summarize the recorded relationship interpretations for verified excerpts; provenance establishes quotation grounding, not whether an interpretation is true or broadly representative. The complete run set contains 1 recomputed source group; confirmed independent authorship is unavailable. Search snippets were treated as discovery leads only and were excluded from claim outcomes. No collection coverage gaps were recorded for this run. No current alternatives were supplied; ask participants what they use or do today. An unknown alternative set is not evidence that no alternatives exist.
